Since \(p\) is a positive integer and the right side is \(25/19 < 2\), we must have \(p=1\).

Then
\[
1+\frac{1}{q+\frac1r}=\frac{25}{19}
\]
so
\[
\frac{1}{q+\frac1r}=\frac{6}{19}.
\]
Thus
\[
q+\frac1r=\frac{19}{6}=3+\frac16.
\]
Since \(r\) is a positive integer, \(q=3\) and \(r=6\).

\boxed{3}
